image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features colorful illustrations of food dishes (including what appears to be curry, rice, and desserts) alongside text descriptions and prices. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or AI-generated artifacts rather than real language. There are reflections on the glossy surface, indicating lamination.
